metadata.title: On Alternateness of the Jones-Kauffman Polynomial of Virtual Links
metadata.abstract: We study alternateness of the Jones-Kauffman polynomial of virtual links. In particular, we identify a class of virtual links with alternating Jones-Kauffman polynomial that will be called the class of mock-alternating virtual links. Then, we explain how every mock-alternating virtual link can give rise to an infinite family of mock-alternating virtual links using the twisting technique introduced in [4] and later generalized in [5,18]. Finally, we give a connected state expansion of the mock-determinant for checkerboard-colorable links.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 定义 Jones–Kauffman polynomial 交错的 mock-alternating virtual link 类，经 twisting 生成无限家族，并对 checkerboard-colourable link 给 mock-determinant connected state expansion。
analysis.breakthrough: 推广交错多项式家族的构造与行列式状态表达。
analysis.limitations: mock-alternating 指 polynomial 性质，不保证 link 有 alternating diagram。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 仅少量辅助排版、语法纠正和改写，以改善可读性及语言；作者审阅并承担数学责任。
